title: First Synchronization
summary: Ha-Jun returns to his solitary apartment and undertakes the agonizing 5% Bloodline Synchronization with Kuro's guidance. Unlocking the 5-meter Sovereign Domain, his mana ripple is immediately detected by the Demon Hunter Bureau across the city.

panels.action: Wide establishing shot of Saint Mirren University gates at dusk; sodium streetlights cast yellow reflections across rain-soaked asphalt.
panels.prose_en: Saint Mirren University gates at dusk; sodium streetlights cast yellow reflections across rain-soaked asphalt.
panels.prose_hi: Godhuli bela mein sent miren vishwavidyalaya ke dwar; sodium street lightein baarish se bheege hue damar par pili parchhaiyan dalti han.

panels.shot: walking side by side under umbrella
panels.action: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae walk side by side under Min-Jae's bright yellow umbrella as rain pitter-patters against the fabric.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... tumhare chehre ke cuts kahan gaye?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae walk side by side under Min-Jae's bright yellow umbrella as rain pitter-patters against the fabric.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun aur min-je, min-je ki chamkili pili chhatri ke neeche ek saath chalte hain aur kapde par baarish ki thapki lag rahi hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun casually brushes his fingers against his flawless, unblemished cheek with a faint nonchalant smile.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sirf keechad aur paani tha. Chot utni gehri nahi thi.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun casually brushes his fingers against his flawless, unblemished cheek with a faint nonchalant smile.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek fiki, bedag muskan ke saath laparvahi se apne bedag, bedag gaal par apni ungaliyan firata hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae pushes his round glasses up the bridge of his nose, squinting with persistent suspicion.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ajeeb baat hai... subah toh tumhara hoth kata hua tha.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae pushes his round glasses up the bridge of his nose, squinting with persistent suspicion.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je apne gol chashme ko apni naak ke upar dhakelta hai aur lagatar sandeh ke saath tirchi najrein jhukata hai.

panels.shot: hidden mana pulse under sleeve macro
panels.action: Beneath Ha-Jun's navy blazer sleeve, subtle violet light pulses through his radial veins in perfect sync with his heartbeat.
panels.prose_en: Beneath Ha-Jun's navy blazer sleeve, subtle violet light pulses through his radial veins in perfect sync with his heartbeat.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki navy blazer aasteen ke niche, sookshm baingani prakash uske dil ki dhadkan ke saath sahi taalmel mein uski radial nason ke madhyam se spandit hota hai.

panels.action: Kuro's telepathic warning echoes in Ha-Jun's consciousness: 'Yeh ladka zaroorat se zyada tez hai. Doori banao.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Isse door raho, warna yeh bhi maara jayega.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's telepathic warning echoes in Ha-Jun's consciousness: 'Yeh ladka zaroorat se zyada tez hai. Doori banao.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki chetna mein kuro ki telepathic chetavani goonjati hai: 'ye ladka zaruri se zyada tez hai. 'duri banao.'

panels.action: They pause at a pedestrian crossing under flickering traffic signals; Min-Jae turns to wave goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Kal milte hain, Ha-Jun. Dhyan rakhna.

panels.prose_en: They pause at a pedestrian crossing under flickering traffic signals; Min-Jae turns to wave goodbye.
panels.prose_hi: Ve timtimate yatayat sanketon ke neeche paidal yatri crossing par rukte han; min-je alvida kahne ke liye mudta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks alone into a narrow residential alley, his reflection trailing behind him in cold puddle ripples.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kal tak... main ek bilkul alag insaan tha.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks alone into a narrow residential alley, his reflection trailing behind him in cold puddle ripples.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ek sankari avasiya gali mein akela chalta hai, uska pratibimb thandi pokhar ki laharon mein uske peeche peeche chal raha hai.

panels.action: Low-angle view of a modest, aging four-story apartment complex with rusted exterior stairwells against the dark sky.

dialogue.text: Wo ghar jahan saat saal se sirf khamoshi rehti thi.

panels.prose_en: Aging four-story apartment complex with rusted exterior stairwells against the dark sky.
panels.prose_hi: Purane char manjila apartment parisar mein andhere aakash ke samne jung lagi bahari sidhiyan han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps inside his dark entryway, locking all three heavy metal deadbolts with deliberate speed.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps inside his dark entryway, locking all three heavy metal deadbolts with deliberate speed.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne andhere pravesh dwar ke andar kadam rakhta hai, aur sabhi teen bhari dhatu ke dedbolt ko jaanbujhkar gati se band kar deta hai.

panels.action: A framed photograph on the desk: 10yo smiling Ha-Jun standing beside his tall, proud elder brother Kang Tae-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhaiya... main bohot jald aa raha hoon.

panels.prose_en: A framed photograph on the desk: 10-year-old smiling Ha-Jun standing beside his tall, proud elder brother Kang Tae-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Desk par ek fremayukt tasweer: 10 varshiya muskurata hua ha-jun apne lambe, garvit bade bhai kang taaye-jun ke saath khada hai.

panels.action: Kuro rises up smoothly from Ha-Jun's cast shadow on the wooden floor, perching atop a tall bookshelf with glowing eyes.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Bohot achha ghonsla hai. Ab chalo, asli pariksha shuru karein.

panels.prose_en: Kuro rises up smoothly from Ha-Jun's cast shadow on the wooden floor, perching atop a tall bookshelf with glowing eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro lakdi ke farsh par ha-jun ki chhaya se aasani se upar uthta hai, chamakti aankhon ke saath ek lambe bukashelf ke upar baithta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun strips off his soaked uniform blazer; his torso is completely healed with sharp, defined, supernatural musculature.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Meri body... ek hi ghante mein itni badal gayi?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun strips off his soaked uniform blazer; his torso is completely healed with sharp, defined, supernatural musculature.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ne apni bheegi hui vardi ka blazer utaar diya; uska dhad tej, paribhashit, alaukik mansalta se puri tarah theek ho gaya hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun sits cross-legged on the floor mat, hands resting palm-up on his knees, calming his breathing.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits cross-legged on the floor mat, hands resting palm-up on his knees, calming his breathing.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun farsh ki chatai par cross-legd baithta hai, haath uske ghutnon par hatheli-upar rakhte han, jisse uski saansein shant hoti han.

panels.action: The system window appears: [BEGIN 5% BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION? WARNING: SEVERE NERVOUS STRAIN].

dialogue.text: [INITIATE 5% BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION?]

panels.prose_en: The system window appears: [BEGIN 5% BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION? WARNING: SEVERE NERVOUS STRAIN].
panels.prose_hi: Sistm window prakat hoti hai: [5% raktarekha tulyakalan shuru karen? chetavni: gambhir tantrika tanav].

panels.action: Kuro flaps his obsidian wings, channeling pure streams of violet demonic fire directly into Ha-Jun's sternum core.
panels.prose_en: Kuro flaps his obsidian wings, channeling pure streams of violet demonic fire directly into Ha-Jun's sternum core.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne obsidian pankhon ko fadfadata hai, baingani rakshasi aag ki shuddh dharaon ko sidhe ha-jun ke urosthi core mein pravahit karta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's back arches violently as every vein in his chest and neck illuminates with blinding ultraviolet light.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's back arches violently as every vein in his chest and neck illuminates with blinding ultraviolet light.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki peeth teji se jhukti hai kyonki uski chhati aur gardan ki har nas chakachaundh kar dene wali parabaingani roshni se chamakti hai.

panels.action: Cosmic psychic vision: Colossal demon armies clashing across burning worlds beneath shattered galaxies.

dialogue.text: Hazaron yuddho ki cheekhein uske dimaag mein goonjne lagin.

panels.prose_en: Cosmic psychic vision: Colossal demon armies clashing across burning worlds beneath shattered galaxies.
panels.prose_hi: Brahmandiy mansik drishti: vishal danav senaen bikhri hui akashgangaon ke neeche jalti hui duniya mein sangharsh kar rahi han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun grits his teeth until sparks fly in his vision, refusing to lose consciousness: 'MAIN NAHI TOOTUNGA!!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN NAHI TOOTUNGA! BHAIYA MERA INTEZAR KAR RAHE HAIN!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grits his teeth until sparks fly in his vision, refusing to lose consciousness: 'MAIN NAHI TOOTUNGA!!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne daant pista rahata hai jab tak ki uski drishti mein chingari na ud jaye, hosh khone se inkaar kar deta hai: 'main nahin tutunga!!'.

panels.action: The chaotic wild flames suddenly collapse and crystallize into a serene, perfect violet orb orbiting inside his heart.
panels.prose_en: The chaotic wild flames suddenly collapse and crystallize into a serene, perfect violet orb orbiting inside his heart.
panels.prose_hi: Arajk junglee laptein achanak dhah jaati hain aur uske hriday ke andar parikrama karte hue ek shant, paripoorn baingani gole mein cristlikrit ho jaati han.

panels.action: A golden-purple chime: [SYNCHRONIZATION COMPLETED: 5.0%] | [SOVEREIGN DOMAIN (STAGE 1: 5 METERS) UNLOCKED].

dialogue.text: [SYNCHRONIZATION: 5.0% COMPLETE] [DOMAIN UNLOCKED]

panels.prose_en: A golden-purple chime: [SYNCHRONIZATION COMPLETED: 5.0%] | [SOVEREIGN DOMAIN (STAGE 1: 5 METERS) UNLOCKED].
panels.prose_hi: Ek sunhari-bangni jhankar: [sinkranization purn: 5.0%] | [soweren domain (charan 1:5 meter) unlock].

panels.action: A transparent sphere of radiant violet energy expands 5 meters outward from Ha-Jun, enveloping the entire living room.
panels.prose_en: A transparent sphere of radiant violet energy expands 5 meters outward from Ha-Jun, enveloping the entire living room.
panels.prose_hi: Ujjwal baingani urja ka ek pardarshi kshetra ha-jun se 5 meter bahar ki or failta hai, jo poore living room ko cover karta hai.

panels.action: Inside the 5-meter domain, dust motes and water droplets dripping from his hair freeze suspended motionless in mid-air.

dialogue.text: Is daayre ke andar... hawa aur samay uske adheen the.

panels.prose_en: Inside the 5-meter domain, dust motes and water droplets dripping from his hair freeze suspended motionless in mid-air.
panels.prose_hi: 5 meter ke dayre ke ander, uske baalon se tapakti dhul ke kan aur pani ki bunden hawa mein sthir roop se latki hui han.

panels.action: Kuro nods in deep awe: 'Sirf 5% par hi Domain manifest kar liya... Tum sach mein uske sacche waris ho.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Kamaal hai. Tumhara potential First Sovereign se bhi tez hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro nods in deep awe: 'Sirf 5% par hi Domain manifest kar liya... Tum sach mein uske sacche waris ho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne gahri vismay mein sir hilaya: 'sirf 5% par hi domain menefest kar liya... tum sach mein uske sacche waris ho.'

panels.action: An invisible concentric shockwave of sovereign mana radiates out of the apartment building, rippling into the city sky.
panels.prose_en: An invisible concentric shockwave of sovereign mana radiates out of the apartment building, rippling into the city sky.
panels.prose_hi: Samprabhu man ki ek adrishya sankendrit shockwev apartment imarat se nikalkar shahar ke aakash mein tarangit ho rahi hai.

panels.action: Cut to a high-tech obsidian control room overlooking the city; complex holographic radar maps illuminate the dark room.

dialogue.text: Demon Hunter Bureau — Sector 4 Command.

panels.prose_en: Cut to a high-tech obsidian control room overlooking the city; complex holographic radar maps illuminate the dark room.
panels.prose_hi: Shahar ki or dekhne wale ek uchch takneek obsidian niyantran kaksh mein katauti; jatil holographic radar manchitra andhere kamre ko roshan karte han.

panels.action: An antique silver and brass demonic compass on the control console spins wildly before locking sharply onto Ha-Jun's neighborhood.
panels.prose_en: An antique silver and brass demonic compass on the control console spins wildly before locking sharply onto Ha-Jun's neighborhood.
panels.prose_hi: Niyantran console par ek prachin chandi aur pital ka rakshasi compass ha-jun ke pados par teji se lock hone se pehle bethasha ghumta hai.

panels.shot: hunter captain profile in white coat
panels.action: A tall, cold-eyed man in a tailored white coat with a glowing silver cross insignia picks up an encrypted communicator.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Sector 4 mein Sovereign-class energy spike detect hua hai.

panels.prose_en: A tall, cold-eyed man in a tailored white coat with a glowing silver cross insignia picks up an encrypted communicator.
panels.prose_hi: Chamakte chandi ke cross prateek chinh ke saath sile hue safed coat mein ek lamba, thandi aankhon wala aadmi ek encrypted communicator uthata hai.

panels.action: The Hunter Captain's eyes narrow into slits: 'Black Squad ko tayar karo. Is baar shaitan ka beej bachkar nahi nikalna chahiye.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Squad deploy karo. Target ko zinda ya murda pakdo.

panels.prose_en: The Hunter Captain's eyes narrow into slits: 'Black Squad ko tayar karo. Is baar shaitan ka beej bachkar nahi nikalna chahiye.'.
panels.prose_hi: Hunter captain ki aankhen patli ho gain: 'black squad ko taiyar karo. is baar shaitan ka beej bachkar nahin nikalna chahiye.'

panels.action: Back in the apartment, Ha-Jun closes his fist, dissolving the domain into a calm breath, eyes burning with violet majesty: 'Aane do unhe.'
panels.mood: calm before the storm, ultimate cliffhanger

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Jo bhi aaye... main taiyar hoon.

panels.prose_en: Back in the apartment, Ha-Jun closes his fist, dissolving the domain into a calm breath, eyes burning with violet majesty: 'Aane do unhe.'.
panels.prose_hi: Apartment mein vaaps, ha-jun ne apni mutthi band kar li, domain ko ek shant saans mein ghol diya, aankhen baingani mahima se jal rahi thin: 'aane do unhen.'
